title: Crispy Fried Rice
description: A simple and quick Ukrainian-inspired fried rice dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the crunch of fried onions with the savory flavors of cooked rice.

ingredients.name: Khao khua
ingredients.notes: Thai fried rice seasoning or substitute with paprika and salt

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes.
Add the fried onions, khao khua, and salt. Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
